title: Patient Hardship Discount Program: Limit on Pending and Approved Cases per Patient
content:
**Rule.** Under the Patient Hardship Discount Program a patient holds at most 2 hardship cases that are pending or approved: one approved determination and one renewal application. A new application is not accepted while the patient already has an application pending; a renewal application is accepted only within the level's renewal window, counted in calendar days before the current determination's expiry date.

### The rule in three parts

1. **Ceiling.** No more than 2 of the patient's cases may be pending or approved at once, and those 2 are one approved determination and one renewal application.
2. **One pending application.** While an application from the patient is pending, no new application is accepted.
3. **Renewal timing.** An application made while the patient holds an approved determination is a renewal application, and it is accepted only within the renewal window before that determination's expiry date.

### Whose records decide

Whether an application is already pending is read from the program's own case records for that patient as applicant (the guarantor) before the new application is taken: a case on file for the same patient with the status *application pending* is what bars the new one. The case records, not the caller's account of them, are the authority.

Cases that are denied, expired or revoked are neither pending nor approved, so they do not count toward the 2.

### Position table

| The patient's pending or approved cases on file | Effect of this limit on a further application |
|---|---|
| None | The limit does not bar it |
| One application pending | Not accepted |
| One approved determination, no application pending, application made within the renewal window | Not barred by this limit; it is the renewal application |
| One approved determination, no application pending, application made before the renewal window opens | Not accepted |
| One approved determination and one renewal application pending | Not accepted: an application is pending and the ceiling of 2 is reached |

### Hypothetical illustration

A patient holds an approved determination and has nothing pending. An application made well before the renewal window opens is not accepted; the same patient applying inside the window is not barred by this limit. Once that renewal application is on file and pending, a third application is not accepted.
